user.title: MagicBand
user.description: Logs bands tapped on your MagicBand readers, lets you give bands to people, and keeps every reader's allowed list in sync.

assign_band.title: Add or assign a band
assign_band.description: Tap the band on a reader first, then choose it here (most recent first) and who it belongs to. Bands belonging to an allowed person get the welcome on every reader.

data_description.label: For example 'blue MagicBand+'. Useful when someone has several bands.

new_person.title: New person
new_person.description: People don't need to be Home Assistant users. Link one only if you want automations to know which HA person tapped in.

remove_person.title: Remove a person
remove_person.description: Their bands are kept but become unassigned, so they'll be denied.

remove_band.title: Remove a band
remove_band.description: Forget a band completely. If it's tapped again it shows up as new.

error.name_taken: There's already a person with that name.

abort.no_bands: No bands yet. Tap a band on a MagicBand reader first.
abort.no_people: No people yet. Add one first.

add_person.name: Add person
add_person.description: Add someone who can be given bands.

allowed.name: Allowed
allowed.description: Whether their bands get the welcome.

update_person.name: Update person
update_person.description: Rename, link or allow/deny a person.

person.name: Person
person.description: Name or ID of the person.

ha_person.name: Home Assistant person
ha_person.description: Linked HA person, or empty to unlink.

allowed.name: Allowed
allowed.description: Whether their bands get the welcome.

remove_person.name: Remove person
remove_person.description: Remove a person. Their bands become unassigned.

person.name: Person
person.description: Name or ID of the person.

assign_band.name: Assign band
assign_band.description: Give a band to a person.

band.name: Band
band.description: Band ID, or 'last' for the most recently tapped band.

person.name: Person
person.description: Name or ID of the person.

unassign_band.name: Unassign band
unassign_band.description: Take a band away from its person (it will be denied).

sync.name: Sync readers
sync.description: Send the allowed list to every reader now.

send.name: Send MagicBand effect
send.description: Light up and/or buzz MagicBand+ bands through the MagicBand bridges (all of them unless you pick some).

color.name: Colour
color.description: Palette colour (red, pink, lime_green, …): single colour, centre for two colours, first crossfade colour.

color2.name: Second colour
color2.description: Outer ring for two colours; second crossfade colour.

colors.name: Five colours
colors.description: Comma-separated: centre, top right, bottom right, bottom left, top left.

rgb_color.name: Custom colour
rgb_color.description: Any colour, for the rgb effect.

on_seconds.name: On time
on_seconds.description: Seconds the band stays lit (0 = default).

always_on.name: Stay on
always_on.description: Stay lit until the next command or 'off'.

duration_ms.name: Broadcast time
duration_ms.description: How long each bridge broadcasts, in ms (0 = default 2 s).

command.name: Raw command
command.description: A full command object (advanced); other fields are ignored.

bridges.name: Bridges
bridges.description: Command entities of the bridges to use. Leave empty for all bridges.

list_bridges.name: List MagicBand bridges
list_bridges.description: Return the Command entities of every MagicBand bridge.
